summary: Source-derived map of ReaLMM. The graph is the cross-links. Each map file is one slice: process layers, chat stages, HTTP, console, configuration, tests, and how the processes are run. Evidence is code, tests, YAML, and JSON. Markdown files were not opened.

files.role: Nodes and directed edges across modules, ports, adapters, routes, stores, the console, and a few locking tests.
Composition root, GatewayRuntime lifecycle, and port-to-adapter wiring.
Stage order inside ChatService and the HTTP error map.
Next pages, hooks, and which gateway routes they call.
Settings precedence, YAML presets, and on-disk state paths.
What each Python module and the web suite lock, from test names plus the files that were read in full.
Compose, Docker, CI, and the screenshot capture file.

relations: graph.json edges implements and calls are expanded in map/system.json and map/chat-pipeline.json.
graph.json route nodes match map/http.json. Console edges to those routes are expanded in map/console.json.
PolicyYamlSource and the data/* stores in the graph are explained in map/config.json.
tested_by edges in the graph point at architecture, pipeline, and settings. map/tests.json lists the rest of the suite.
compose and CI nodes are expanded in map/ops.json.
uncertainties: pydantic dotenv_settings is in settings_customise_sources, but GatewaySettings.model_config sets env_file to None. The .env file is applied by load_dotenv_once(override=False) into os.environ before GatewaySettings() is built, so those keys are seen as environment. tests/test_settings.py locks that process env wins over dotenv.
File secrets are the last source in the tuple. No file-secret path was traced beyond that return value.

Provider detection calls LiteLLM _infer_valid_provider_from_env_vars and then keeps names that have an API key, with an extra ollama branch. The local compat-base table names groq, openai, deepseek, xai, mistral, openrouter, together_ai, cerebras, fireworks_ai, nvidia_nim, and ollama. Other providers LiteLLM can infer are not listed in that table.
validate_output runs on complete() only when response_format is set. The stage-order test does not include it.
StreamFallback is conditional on a model change. The event-order test's recorder always produces a fallback, so the locked tail is StreamFallback, StreamUsage, StreamFinished for that fixture.
data/gateway-keys.json, data/budget-state.json, and data/runtime-flags.json were not opened. Paths are from bootstrap and RuntimeFlagStore.
tests/conftest.py, factories, and fakes were not read line by line. Suite roles in map/tests.json come from def test_ names, except architecture and pipeline, which were read.
Markdown, including openwiki pages and README, was not used. Anything that exists only there is absent from this folder.
